reasoning: The icon clearly depicts the standard media 'shuffle' symbol (two crossing arrows pointing right) enclosed in a solid square button. While mainly an interface toggle for media players, it serves well as a literal or close symbol for tasks centered on randomizing, shuffling decks/flashcards, drawing lots, or A/B routing, though total task volume in everyday life is relatively narrow.

pass1.ambiguity: Can be confused with fullscreen/expand arrows or close ('X') buttons at very small sizes, though the two right-pointing arrowheads clearly indicate shuffle.
